title: Syril Karn
description: Syril Karn was Deputy Inspector for Pre-Mor Enforcement. He deduced that Cassian Andor killed two Pre-Mor officers. Karn tried to capture Andor on Ferrix, but the operation went badly. Though Karn was disgraced, he created reports on Andor that caught the eye of Dedra Meero. When the crowed rioted after Maarva Andor's funeral, Karn pulled Meero to safety.
